L_definition: fraction with k <= max(1, 0.1*t) at final round
note: Under norm100 the calibration gives q_hat ~ 0 (agents behave as the BNR rule), so a match of the norm100 arm to the BNR simulator is close to automatic. The informative tests are (i) whether agents stay decisive at the high scores populations reach (calibration covers levels up to 30), and (ii) the 'ended' control arm, which the kernel predicts breaks the BNR pattern.
